result.summary: Found 1 issue: a restaurant card in the Popular right now section shows a broken image placeholder instead of a photo.

issues.description: The first card under 'Popular right now' (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) displays a gray box with a generic broken-image icon instead of a restaurant photo, while the delivery badge and favorite button still render over it.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant image for this card, and provide a styled fallback (e.g., a branded placeholder) so a broken-image icon is never shown to users.
